title: Deep Learning to Estimate RECIST in Patients with NSCLC Treated with PD-1 Blockade
summary: A supervised deep-learning NLP model estimated RECIST response/progression from NSCLC radiology reports, enabling scalable measurement of treatment-specific outcomes. Blinded internal holdout plus independent external institution and expert RECIST ground truth; authors limit use to retrospective research, not real-time care.
ai_technology: A fully connected network used tokenized longitudinal report text and radiologist RECIST labels to predict response and progression timing.
organization: Affiliation not stated in the reviewed material

evidence.tested: Internal and external test cohorts showed response classification and progression-date agreement with radiologist RECIST; external test included 97 patients.
evidence.unknown: Blinded internal holdout plus independent external institution and expert RECIST ground truth; authors limit use to retrospective research, not real-time care. The source does not establish benefits beyond the reported evaluation.
evidence.ai_role: A fully connected network used tokenized longitudinal report text and radiologist RECIST labels to predict response and progression timing.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
